notes: DiscoFlate v3.65.0 — a SCENE is now the whole show. It owns its overlays, its commands, its triggers, its chat buttons, its wording and its limits, so picking a scene picks everything at once and a command can never point at a group from some other scene. Gameplay settings are gone as a separate idea — the Dashboard and Game tabs with them; everything they held lives on Scenes. Ships with a read-only 'DiscoFlate Default' to compare against and an editable 'Your Scene' to build on. Existing setups migrate into a scene of their own with nothing lost.
